name: postprocessing-pipeline
description: Build a correct three.js post-processing chain: EffectComposer with RenderPass, ambient occlusion (GTAOPass), bloom (UnrealBloomPass), OutputPass for tone mapping and sRGB, and antialiasing with an MSAA render target or SMAAPass, plus the WebGPU equivalent with RenderPipeline and TSL nodes (pass, bloom). Use when adding bloom, glow, ambient occlusion, SSAO, antialiasing or any screen effect, or when a scene gets washed out, too dark, banded, jagged or loses its colors after adding EffectComposer, or when porting post-processing to WebGPURenderer.
